season one does not automatically reveal her human identity to players

designAssumptions: this is not a body or avatar but a non-humanoid evidence placeholder: one anonymous featureless matte-black maintenance terminal module with a completely blank screen and smooth casing
a single red insulated cable links the module to one small plain battery
an open unmarked toolbox below contains only a wrench, screwdriver, pliers, small hammer, flashlight, roll of duct tape and loose screws, arranged as maintenance traces
sceneConcept: A non-humanoid evidence placeholder for the unidentified developer known as Red Queen is shown as a centered still life against a transparent background. One anonymous featureless matte-black maintenance terminal module has a completely blank screen and smooth casing. A single red insulated cable links the module to one small plain battery. Below it, one open unmarked toolbox contains only a wrench, screwdriver, pliers, small hammer, flashlight, roll of duct tape and loose screws. Soft even frontal studio light makes this a maintenance-trace asset rather than a body or avatar.
naturalLanguageDetail: A non-humanoid evidence placeholder shows one anonymous featureless matte-black maintenance terminal with a completely blank screen and smooth casing linked by a single red insulated cable to one small plain battery, above one open unmarked toolbox containing only a wrench, screwdriver, pliers, small hammer, flashlight, roll of duct tape and loose screws under soft even frontal studio light.
